title: An integrative approach to infer systematic relationships and define species groups in the shrub frog genus Raorchestes, with description of five new species from the Western Ghats, India.

readScopes.readScope: Raorchestes drutaahu: New-species diagnostic combination, five-specimen variation, call description, two-locality habitat and phylogenetic placement; no independent current conservation assessment; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
Raorchestes kakkayamensis: Diagnostic morphology and six-specimen variation, single-locality habitat, typical-call properties and sequence relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Raorchestes keirasabinae: Three-specimen morphology and colour hypothesis, canopy distribution, expressly unanalysed vocalisations and mitochondrial comparisons within wider multilocus study; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
Raorchestes sanjappai: Three-specimen diagnosis, secondary-forest breeding-season perches, typical widely spaced pulses and sister relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Raorchestes vellikkannan: Male diagnostic range and live versus preserved holotype appearance, primary-forest perches, missing acoustic analysis and sister relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Raorchestes bombayensis: Comparison with sanctisilvaticus explicitly without taxonomic merger, population-variable morphology and unresolved acoustic-duration attribution; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
